::: {#def-effective-parameters}
#### Effective number of parameters

Let $\overline{\dicdev} \eqdef \E{\dicdevf{\vparam} \mid \vy}$ be the posterior mean of the [deviance](#def-bayes-deviance),
and let $\bar{\vparam} \eqdef \E{\vparam \mid \vy}$ be the posterior mean of the parameters.
The **effective number of parameters** is

$$
p_D \eqdef \overline{\dicdev} - \dicdevf{\bar{\vparam}}.
$$
:::
